SELECT
    COUNT(*)
    FROM eds.TRU_CUST AS CUST --51314
        LEFT JOIN eds.TRU_BASELINK AS BASE --65683
            ON CUST.CUST_NO = BASE.CIF_NO
            AND CAST('2023-03-21' AS DATE) BETWEEN BASE.SCD_START_DATE AND BASE.SCD_END_DATE
        LEFT JOIN eds.TRU_PORTFOLIO AS PORT --184335
            ON BASE.CUST_NO = PORT.BASE_NO
            AND CAST('2023-03-21' AS DATE) BETWEEN PORT.SCD_START_DATE AND PORT.SCD_END_DATE
        LEFT JOIN eds.TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION PFSUB --184335
            ON PORT.SUBSCRIPTION_ID = PFSUB.SUBSCRIPTION_ID
            AND PORT.BASE_NO = PFSUB.BASE_NO
            AND CAST('2023-03-21' AS DATE) BETWEEN PFSUB.SCD_START_DATE AND PFSUB.SCD_END_DATE
        LEFT JOIN eds.TRU_AUMNONUITF NONUITF --71001283
            ON NONUITF.BASE_NO = PORT.BASE_NO
            AND NONUITF.PF_NO = PORT.PORTFOLIO_NO
            AND CAST('2023-03-21' AS DATE) = NONUITF.AS_OF_DATE
        LEFT JOIN eds.TRU_AUMUITF UITF --71001283
            ON UITF.BASE_NO = PORT.BASE_NO
            AND UITF.PORTFOLIO_NO = PORT.PORTFOLIO_NO
            AND CAST('2023-03-21' AS DATE) = UITF.AS_OF_DATE
    WHERE 
	CAST('2023-03-21' AS DATE) BETWEEN CUST.SCD_START_DATE AND CUST.SCD_END_DATE
     AND PORT.STATUS = 'A' --70988351
